title: Flat replacement of a bounded-above model
statement: For a derived sheaf-module object E admitting a bounded-above complex representative, there is a bounded-above termwise flat complex representative of E.

proof.text: Choose a bounded representative K, its upper bound b, and an isomorphism e:E≅Q(K) from the hypothesis. Apply lem-pc-kflat-bounded-flat-replacement on the ringed site of B to K with bound b, obtaining a termwise flat complex F zero above b and a quasi-isomorphism ε:F→K. Localization makes Q(ε) invertible. The composite e followed by Q(ε) inverse identifies E with Q(F). No Mayer--Vietoris construction or truncation is needed.
